baseline_models.focus_anchor: كتاب فصلت آياته قرآنا عربيا ... يعلمون
baseline_models.mechanism: The book joins written matter, differentiates it into legible sign-units, regathers those units in recitation, and renders them explicit in Arabic for recognition.

activation_trace.role: Joining one thing to another supplies the book's assembled substrate.
Ordered letters and the written object make that assembly an inscription.
Detailing that distinguishes parts and meanings makes the inscription resolvable.
The visible mark gives each differentiated unit evidentiary salience.
Gathering reunites the separated units into a coherent whole.
Reading and recitation make the gathered whole performable and hearable.
Explicit expression and eloquence supply the intelligible linguistic medium.
Disclosure to a knower completes the transmission from inscription to recognition.

changed_reading.before: An Arabic book whose verses have been explained for knowledgeable people.
changed_reading.after: An engineered sign-system whose writing, differentiation, recitation, explicit language, and recognition form one transmission mechanism.

baseline_models.mechanism: The book can carry binding determination while its detailing cuts discriminating boundaries, so explanation also has normative and adjudicative force.

activation_trace.role: An established writing that obligates judgment gives the book binding force.
Judgment separating truth from falsehood makes detailing a decisive partition.
Knowledge makes the partition cognitively answerable rather than merely formal.

changed_reading.after: The signs are delimited so clearly that they can distinguish claims and support judgment.

baseline_models.mechanism: The addressee is not an isolated decoder but a people capable of standing, undertaking, and maintaining a shared response to disclosed knowledge.

activation_trace.role: A human collective supplies the social bearer of the reading.
Rising with resolve turns the collective from an audience into an undertaking body.
Care and sustained oversight make knowledge a maintained communal charge.
Cognitive disclosure names the capacity around which the collective coheres.

changed_reading.before: The text is for people who possess knowledge.
changed_reading.after: The text addresses a knowing collective expected to stand up in and maintain what becomes clear.

baseline_models.mechanism: Separation does not destroy unity: signs function like joints or controlled divisions whose boundaries let the recited whole articulate and move.

activation_trace.role: A joint between two members supplies a mobile boundary rather than a rupture.
Divisions regulating speech and verse supply the recitation's controlled segmentation.
Gathering makes the bounded parts operate as one recited body.

changed_reading.after: Detailing gives the recitation joints: bounded units that preserve coherence by making articulation possible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The assembled sign-system is conveyed from a source and hidden impartation becomes inscribed, articulated material available to an audience.

activation_trace.role: Bringing a thing down and delivering it supplies the motion into the focus's book.
Secret impartation of knowledge supplies the initially hidden communicative source.
Writing and inscription bridge hidden impartation to the written book.
The later repeated delivery confirms descent as the book's transmission frame.
The written object is the stable receiving form of that delivery.

structural_cues: 41:2 immediately prefixes the focus with a nominal descent.
41:6 locates hidden communication in a human messenger, while 41:42 returns to descent after describing the book's resistance to falsehood.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies delivery, hidden impartation, writing, and the book; I infer a source-to-inscription-to-audience direction. The live alternative is that descent marks provenance without describing stages of mediation.

changed_reading.before: The focus describes a finished Arabic book.
changed_reading.after: The focus describes the stabilized, articulated landing-form of knowledge conveyed into humanly accessible signs.

context_deltas.mechanism: Explicit differentiation is an affordance, not automatic comprehension: turning away, failed hearing, protective covers, auditory weight, and an intervening barrier can interrupt the path from sign to knowledge.

activation_trace.role: Turning one's side away supplies active withdrawal from the offered disclosure.
Hearing as understanding and compliance makes failed hearing a failed uptake, not mere acoustics.
A preserving cover becomes a receiver-side enclosure that keeps the call out.
Weight in the ear supplies resistance within the auditory channel.
Prevention of access makes the interpersonal barrier functionally explicit.
Clarity names what the message supplies even when the receiver blocks it.
Knowledge is the endpoint that the layered impedances prevent.

structural_cues: 41:4 places turning away and not hearing directly after the focus's promise of clarity.
41:5 stacks barriers at heart, ear, and interpersonal space rather than naming one lack of information.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a serial cluster of withdrawal, covers, weight, and barrier; I infer a layered reception pathway. These may alternatively be parallel idioms for rejection rather than literal stages.

changed_reading.before: Arabic detailing ensures that knowledgeable hearers understand.
changed_reading.after: Arabic detailing removes message-side obscurity while leaving attention, hearing, disposition, and social distance as live points of failure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ordered creation sequence supplies a material analogue for detailing: measured limits, stabilizers, provisions, completed layers, and safeguards make differentiation productive rather than fragmentary.

activation_trace.role: Distinguishing parts and meanings anchors the analogy in the focus's detailing.
Measuring a thing before or in making it supplies calibrated formation.
Fixity and rooted stability show one differentiated component securing the whole.
Stable, growing good makes ordered placement generative.
Deliberate apportionment supplies the governing measure across parts.
Sustenance that preserves life gives the measured order a recipient-oriented function.
Perfecting manufacture and carrying action through closes the layered sequence.
Guarding and preserving show that the completed arrangement is maintained.

structural_cues: 41:9-12 proceeds through earth, stabilizers, blessing, apportioned sustenance, heaven, completed layers, assignment, adornment, and protection.
Repeated time counts and the distribution of an order to each heaven reinforce bounded sequencing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies calibrated creation and the focus supplies differentiated signs; I infer that the creation sequence models what productive detailing does. It may instead be a separate demonstration with no text-world isomorphism.

changed_reading.after: The signs are architected like a provisioned world: bounded and ordered so each part stabilizes, feeds, and preserves the whole.

context_deltas.mechanism: Signs become distributed evidence: hearing, sight, and skin testify; the horizons and selves are shown as signs; disclosure converges until truth becomes manifest.

activation_trace.role: The visible mark anchors the focus's signs as evidence-bearing units.
Testimony that states what is known converts bodily data into articulated evidence.
Ordinary sight supplies one embodied witness channel.
The body's outer covering becomes a record-bearing witness.
A sign that speaks by indication explains how nonverbal things can become evidentiary.
The repeated visible signs extend the evidentiary field beyond the book.
Causing to see supplies the directed reveal of that wider field.
Emergence and disclosure provide the result of converging signs.
Stable correspondence with reality names what the disclosure establishes.
Presence with observation frames the encompassing warrant behind all witnesses.

structural_cues: 41:20-22 makes the same hearing that can reject the recitation testify alongside sight and skin.
41:53 explicitly places signs in horizons and selves and gives them a temporal endpoint: until the truth becomes clear.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bodily testimony and outward/inward signs; I infer one distributed evidentiary network that extends the focus's sign-units. The alternatives are separate forensic and cosmic scenes, or a narrower reference of the focus pronoun to the book's own verses.

changed_reading.before: The book contains signs that knowledgeable people read.
changed_reading.after: The book teaches a grammar of evidence whose signs can be corroborated by perception, body, world, and self until knowledge becomes unavoidable testimony.

context_deltas.mechanism: Recitation is a contested acoustic sequence: deliberate mixed noise can prevent its gathered units from reaching understanding, turning attention itself into the site of struggle.

activation_trace.role: Audible reading and recitation supply the signal being targeted.
Perception of sound identifies the channel the command seeks to close.
Hearing as understanding and compliance exposes the intended downstream loss.
Mixed vocal noise supplies the interference that fragments the recited signal.
Speech-regulating divisions explain what interference prevents listeners from resolving.

structural_cues: 41:26 joins three commands in one tactic: do not listen, generate noise within the recitation, and seek victory.
The focus's ordered recitation is therefore opposed by manufactured disorder rather than by an alternative explanation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recitation, prohibited listening, mixed noise, and a stated aim of prevailing; I infer signal interference against ordered segmentation. The noise may more broadly denote polemical distraction rather than literal acoustic masking.

changed_reading.before: Quran names the gathered content of the book.
changed_reading.after: Quran also names an attention-dependent acoustic event whose ordered distinctions can be strategically jammed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The knowing people are activated as a standing community: upright persistence joins speech, invitation, deliberate work, and a response that transforms hostile distance into protective closeness.

activation_trace.role: The people are the collective whose latent posture is tested by context.
Straightness and balance turn the shared root into an enacted posture.
Voiced speech makes clear expression a public act.
Calling and inclining by speech directs articulation toward another.
Intentional action prevents knowing and speaking from remaining merely verbal.
Pushing away harm supplies the operative reversal of evil by what is better.
Nearness without a gap names the transformed relation produced by that response.

structural_cues: 41:30 repeats the focus root in 'they stood straight' after a spoken confession.
41:33 binds best speech to calling and good action; 41:34 then describes a concrete relational reversal.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated root, speech-action coupling, and enemy-to-intimate transformation; I infer that the focus's knowing people are characterized by enacted standing. Grammatically, qawm in 41:3 can remain simply 'people' without carrying every standing branch.

changed_reading.before: A knowledgeable population is the suitable audience.
changed_reading.after: A people becomes the suitable audience by standing in disclosed knowledge through coherent speech, action, and relation-transforming practice.

context_deltas.mechanism: The late reprise stress-tests the focus: an inaccessible linguistic form would provoke the demand for detailing, while Arabic explicitness makes the protected book traversable as guidance and remedy.

activation_trace.role: The repeated written book identifies the same textual object under pressure.
Cohesion and hardness make the book resistant without making its language opaque.
Departure from truth and stability names what cannot gain access to the book.
Delivery preserves the transmission frame while the book remains protected.
Mastery, precision, and firmness support the book's internally secured construction.
Lack of explicitness and intelligible sound supplies the counterfactual access failure.
The repeated recitation keeps the language test anchored to the focus's Quran.
The demand for distinguished parts and meanings identifies detailing as the remedy for opacity.
The repeated sign-units are what must become accessible.
Explicit expression directly opposes the counterfactual lack of intelligibility.
Gentle direction to a path gives accessible language an orienting function.
Healing and restoration make intelligibility reparative rather than merely informative.

structural_cues: 41:41-42 couples the book's resistance to falsehood with its descent from wisdom.
41:44 repeats Quran, detailing, signs, and Arabic in one counterfactual question, then contrasts guidance and healing with ear-weight and blindness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an Arabic/foreign counterfactual and nearly verbatim focus-root reprise; I infer that Arabic is functioning here as accessible explicitness, not only ethnic classification. The contrast still presupposes actual language communities and should not erase that ordinary sense.

changed_reading.before: Arabic is a descriptive label attached to the Quran.
changed_reading.after: Arabic names the focus's successful access condition: resilient content is differentiated into intelligible speech that can orient and repair, though reception can still fail.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's binding book and truth-cutting detail acquire a forensic trajectory: testimony establishes what was done, a claim becomes due, and judgment separates disputants.

activation_trace.role: Writing that fixes judgment anchors the book's normative capacity.
A judgment separating truth from falsehood anchors detailing as adjudication.
Knowledge-bearing testimony supplies evidence of action.
A fixed, obligatory due supplies the transition from evidence to consequence.
The repeated book carries the dispute into the later judgment scene.
A cutting judgment supplies the explicit verdict mechanism.
Separation and distinction specify what judgment does between disputants.

structural_cues: 41:20-23 sequences action, embodied testimony, mistaken assumptions about knowledge, and loss.
41:45 repeats the book, disagreement, a prior word, and deferred judgment between the parties.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies testimony, fixed consequence, book, dispute, and judgment; I infer a forensic arc latent in the focus's book/detail pair. The focus itself can remain primarily revelatory rather than juridical.

changed_reading.before: Detailing helps readers understand the book.
changed_reading.after: Detailing also prepares claims to be tested: signs distinguish positions, preserve evidence, and support a judgment between them.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it maps wetting and growth onto discourse; it remains anchored through the repeated sign root and the surah's descent vocabulary, but downstream prose should label it a material analogy, not claim that recitation lexically means water.

activation_trace.role: The visible sign anchors the ecological scene back in the focus's signs.
The explicit repeated sign root authorizes the earth scene as activation material.
Delivered descent supplies the incoming medium that reaches dormant ground.
Earth and plant stirring with life supplies the first visible response.
Nourishment and growth supply development after activation.
Earth's life through water completes the material change from latency to manifestation.

changed_reading.before: Detailed signs transfer propositions to people who know.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, delivered signs can act like measured water on receptive ground: articulation makes latent recognition stir, grow, and become visible.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it connects recitation's gathering and detailing's separation to pregnancy, fruit sheaths, and birth; it remains anchored in explicit focus branches and 41:47's knowledge-governed emergence sequence, but should be rendered only as a maturation model, never as the lexical sense of Quran or fussilat here.

activation_trace.role: A womb gathering a load supplies the focus-side image of contained maturation.
Separation of offspring at weaning supplies a timed differentiation from containment.
The plant's sheath and fruit-cover supply one hidden enclosure that later opens.
Inner pregnancy and fruit supply the carried content undergoing maturation.
Setting down a pregnancy in birth supplies emergence from hidden carrying.
Knowledge encompassing the sequence links maturation back to the focus's knowing.

changed_reading.before: Recitation gathers already discrete signs and detailing separates their meanings.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, gathering can be a period of carrying and detailing a timely emergence in which enclosed signs become distinct, fruitful, and knowable.

strongest_changes: Clarity became a transmission system with receiver-side failure points, not a guarantee of comprehension.
The creation sequence made detailing look calibrated, provisioned, and stabilizing rather than merely expansive.
Bodily testimony and horizon/self signs extended the book's sign logic into a distributed evidentiary field.
The 41:44 counterfactual made Arabic function as explicit linguistic access opposed to unintelligibility.
The repeated q-w-m root shifted the knowing people toward an enacted, upright communal posture.
summary.what_was_special: The whole surah repeatedly reactivated nearly every load-bearing focus term, culminating in 41:44's compact reprise of Quran, detailing, signs, and Arabic while other passages tested those terms through blocked hearing, creation, testimony, action, and judgment.
remaining_uncertainties: The focus pronoun on 'signs' can keep the reading book-internal even though later signs occur in body, cosmos, horizons, and selves.
The calibrated-creation parallel may be thematic juxtaposition rather than a model of textual architecture.
The standing sense activated around qawm is contextually vivid but morphologically more distant than the ordinary collective noun.
The irrigation and gestational readings are anchored analogies whose lexical distance requires explicit qualification.
